narrative: The June 6 China Renaissance note frames inference as fragmenting toward custom and dedicated low-latency silicon even with Nvidia dominant, and cites Nvidia folding the licensed Groq LPU line into its Vera Rubin roadmap - a marquee non-GPU accelerator moving into volume deployment. That supports custom/dedicated silicon scaling, the predicted outcome, but offers no shipped-revenue figure.
remaining_gap: No quarterly run-rate dollar figure near the named $20B threshold, and no count of custom-XPU core customers passing six.
